answers:
UPDATE:
For those who are facing this problem like me. I find the solution. If you want to deploy your ML model to the huggingface's space, you need to upload requirement.txt. Yes, requirement.txt is the problem. We don't need to specify the version for each library. For example, gradio==4.22.0, you can write "gradio" instead of a specific version.
Hope this help

nuggets.text: The error encountered when uploading app.py to Hugging Face space is related to the requirements.txt file.
Specifying library versions in requirements.txt can cause issues when deploying to Hugging Face spaces.
Removing specific version numbers from requirements.txt and listing only the library names can resolve the deployment error.
